name: Arms & Armor
pages: There are various materials from which players can craft their {b}armor{/}, {b}tools{/}, and {b}weapons{/}. Each material offers different levels of {!}protection{/}, {!}damage{/}, and other practical {l:combat/armor_bonuses/}bonus effects{/l}.{pb}Most equipment items and gear can also be {l:magic/enchantments/}enchanted{/l} for further improvements. Always choose the right gear for the occasion!

In addition to equipment tiers, {i}arrows{/} also come in a number of {b}variants{/}. Each base variant is crafted using a different material, having its own unique {!}damage value{/} and (in some cases) {!}special effect{/}.{pb}Arrows can be further enhanced by crafting them into {i}spectral arrows{/}, which cause the target to glow when struck, or even {i}tipped arrows{/} that carry a {l:magic/status_effects/}potion effect{/l}. For convenience, players can use a {i}quiver{/} to carry and cycle through their different arrows on-the-go.
